summary: Levering is the most-accepted method to complement ramps (partly from Herodotus and the shadoof); Lehner suggests levers lift only the top ~3% of material, which is 1/3 of the monument's height.
content: Levering methods are considered to be the most tenable solution to complement ramping methods... In Lehner's point of view, levers should be employed to lift the top 3% of the material of the superstructure. The top 4% of this material comprises 1/3 of the total height of the monument.
